regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad eligible rotation (10/16 themes) with Big Banks as the crowded, durable leader. Momentum rank is an attention lens (IC ~0); the absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge (drawdown reduction). No confirmed leadership handoff is underway.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the dominant eligible theme with leading momentum rank and robust durability (0.74). The trend-gate historically curbs drawdown, and the broad rotation supports the leader. Crowding (z=1.59) calls for position size caution, not a fade.
evidence: Rank #1 and high score (1.555) signal attention/focus leadership
Eligible (passed absolute-trend gate) — the most validated risk-control leg
Rotation leader with wide margin (0.802) over challenger
theses.dissent: Crowding could lead to a sharp shake-out if macro narrative shifts (unscheduled-surprise share 0.93); durability is only 'mixed' per Hurst tag.

falsifier.text: If ZEB.TO loses eligibility (relative to the absolute-trend gate) or if Big Banks' rank drops below #3 and durability falls below 0.6, this overweight lean is invalid.

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs are an eligible laggard (rank #11, negative score) with decent but non-leading durability (0.69). In a broad rotation with a clear leader, the laggard tends to continue underperforming unless a sector-specific catalyst emerges.
evidence: Low rank (#11) and negative score (-0.235) indicate relative weakness
Durability bar 0.69 is moderate — not a trend-reversal signal
Eligible, so the trend-gate does not force exit, but momentum is poor
theses.dissent: High breadth (0.917) suggests internal participation still healthy; if rates fall or a rotation into yield plays accelerates, REITs could suddenly outperform.

falsifier.text: If REITs’ rank moves into the top half (#8 or better) with durability above 0.7 for 10 consecutive trading days, this underweight call is wrong.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Despite being eligible, the theme exhibits low durability (0.53) and a 'mean-revert' Hurst tag, signaling a poor trend-following setup. Low breadth (0.533) further reduces conviction in sustained direction. Avoiding eliminates whipsaw risk.
evidence: Durability bar only 0.53 — low staying power
Breadth 0.533 — theme is narrow, many stocks not participating
Rank #5, not extreme, but not compelling
theses.dissent: A commodity spike (geopolitics) or a sudden energy supply disruption could send the theme sharply higher, reversing the mean-revert dynamics.

falsifier.text: If Oil & Gas Producers’ durability rises above 0.65 and the Hurst tag shifts to 'trending' while breadth expands above 0.75, the avoid stance is no longer justified.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
